"""
fig1_overview.py — Conceptual figure for CoRL 2026 paper.
Three-panel overview: (a) Training setup, (b) Factorial design, (c) Dual mechanism.
Fallback matplotlib version (PaperBanana primary).
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# --- Global style ---
COLORS = {
    'vanilla':   '#4C72B0',
    'full_occ':  '#E69F00',
    'random':    '#55A868',
    'detach':    '#C44E52',
    'detach_ln': '#8172B3',
    'depth':     '#937860',

    'encoder_fill':  '#EBF0F7',
    'encoder_edge':  '#4C72B0',
    'llm_fill':      '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':      '#937860',
    'head_fill':     '#FFF3E0',
    'head_edge':     '#E69F00',
    'action_fill':   '#E8F5E9',
    'action_edge':   '#55A868',

    'bn_bad':    '#C44E52',
    'grad_good': '#4C72B0',
    'neutral':   '#7F8C8D',
    'light_bg':  '#FAFBFC',
    'matrix_on': '#E8F0FE',
    'matrix_off':'#FDE8E8',
    'text':      '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':    '#95A5A6',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'text.color': COLORS['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': COLORS['text'],
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5.2), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

# Panel widths: (a) 34%, (b) 27%, (c) 36%
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.02, 0.06, 0.32, 0.86])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.37, 0.06, 0.25, 0.86])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.65, 0.06, 0.33, 0.86])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b, ax_c]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): Training Architecture
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.1, 9.6, '(a) Training Setup', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
          va='top', color=COLORS['text'])

def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['text'], zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=COLORS['subtle'], zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['text'], zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# Camera image
draw_box(ax_a, (3.2, 0.3), 3.6, 1.1, 'RGB Observation', fill='#F0F4F8',
         edge=COLORS['subtle'], fontsize=8)

# Vision encoders
draw_box(ax_a, (1.0, 2.4), 3.0, 1.0, 'DINOv2', sublabel='1024-d patches',
         fill=COLORS['encoder_fill'], edge=COLORS['encoder_edge'])
draw_box(ax_a, (5.5, 2.4), 3.0, 1.0, 'SigLIP', sublabel='1152-d patches',
         fill=COLORS['encoder_fill'], edge=COLORS['encoder_edge'])

# Arrows: image → encoders
draw_arrow(ax_a, (4.2, 1.4), (2.5, 2.4), color=COLORS['encoder_edge'])
draw_arrow(ax_a, (5.8, 1.4), (7.0, 2.4), color=COLORS['encoder_edge'])

# LoRA label
ax_a.text(1.0, 3.65, 'LoRA', fontsize=7, color=COLORS['vanilla'], fontweight='bold',
          ha='center', style='italic',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',
                    edgecolor=COLORS['vanilla'], lw=0.6, alpha=0.9))

# Concat + LLM backbone
draw_box(ax_a, (2.5, 4.2), 5.0, 1.0, 'LLM Backbone', sublabel='Llama-2 7B',
         fill=COLORS['llm_fill'], edge=COLORS['llm_edge'])

draw_arrow(ax_a, (6.5, 5.2), (7.5, 6.0), color=COLORS['head_edge'], lw=1.5)

# L_aux label

draw_arrow(ax_a, (8.3, 7.2), (8.0, 7.0), color=COLORS['head_edge'], lw=1.0)

# Gradient flow annotation
ax_a.annotate('', xy=(6.0, 6.3), xytext=(6.0, 4.8),
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLORS['head_edge'],

ax_a.text(5.6, 5.6, 'grad\nflow?', fontsize=6.5, ha='center',
          color=COLORS['head_edge'], fontweight='bold', style='italic')

# "Discarded at inference" note
ax_a.text(7.5, 8.3, 'discarded at\ninference', fontsize=6.5,
          ha='center', color=COLORS['subtle'], style='italic',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FFF8E1',
                    edgecolor=COLORS['subtle'], lw=0.5, alpha=0.8))
draw_arrow(ax_a, (7.5, 8.0), (7.5, 7.0), color=COLORS['subtle'],
           lw=0.8, style='->')

# ============================================================
# PANEL (b): 2×2 Factorial Design

ax_b.text(0.1, 9.6, '(b) Factorial Design', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
          va='top', color=COLORS['text'])

# Matrix frame
mx, my = 1.0, 1.5
mw, mh = 8.0, 5.5
cell_w, cell_h = mw/2, mh/2

# Column headers
ax_b.text(mx + cell_w * 0.5, my + mh + 0.6, 'Gradient ON',

ax_b.text(mx + cell_w * 1.5, my + mh + 0.6, 'Gradient OFF',
          ha='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['bn_bad'])

# Row headers
ax_b.text(mx - 0.3, my + cell_h * 1.5, 'Structured\nlabels',
          ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold',
          color=COLORS['text'])
ax_b.text(mx - 0.3, my + cell_h * 0.5, 'Random /\nno labels',
          ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold',
          color=COLORS['text'])

# Draw cells
cells = [
    (0, 1, 'Full OCC',    '0.797', COLORS['matrix_on']),
    (1, 1, 'Detach OCC',  '0.746*', COLORS['matrix_off']),
    (0, 0, 'Random OCC',  '0.789', COLORS['matrix_on']),
    (1, 0, 'Vanilla',     '0.780', '#F5F5F5'),
]
# Grid lines
ax_b.plot([mx, mx + mw], [my + cell_h, my + cell_h], color='#DEE2E6', lw=0.8, zorder=1)
ax_b.plot([mx + cell_w, mx + cell_w], [my, my + mh], color='#DEE2E6', lw=0.8, zorder=1)
# Outer border
border = FancyBboxPatch((mx, my), mw, mh, boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.2",
                         facecolor='none', edgecolor='#BDC3C7', linewidth=1.0, zorder=2)
ax_b.add_patch(border)

for col, row, name, car, bg in cells:
    x = mx + col * cell_w
    y = my + row * cell_h
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x + 0.15, y + 0.15), cell_w - 0.3, cell_h - 0.3,

    ax_b.add_patch(box)
    ax_b.text(x + cell_w/2, y + cell_h/2 + 0.35, name,

    car_color = COLORS['bn_bad'] if '*' in car else COLORS['text']
    ax_b.text(x + cell_w/2, y + cell_h/2 - 0.45, f'CAR {car}',

# Column effect arrows
ax_b.annotate('', xy=(mx + 0.3, my + mh + 1.2),
              xytext=(mx + cell_w - 0.3, my + mh + 1.2),
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color=COLORS['grad_good'],

ax_b.text(mx + cell_w/2, my + mh + 1.55, 'gradient flow\ndominates',

          fontweight='bold', style='italic')

# Detach annotation
ax_b.text(mx + cell_w * 1.5, my - 0.3,

# Row effect annotation
ax_b.text(mx + mw + 0.3, my + mh/2,

# ============================================================

ax_c.text(0.1, 9.6, '(c) Dual Mechanism', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',

# Top: "Detach −3.4 pp" source box
draw_box(ax_c, (1.5, 7.8), 7.0, 1.2, 'Detach OCC Degradation',

# Split arrows
draw_arrow(ax_c, (3.5, 7.8), (2.8, 6.8), color=COLORS['bn_bad'], lw=1.5)
draw_arrow(ax_c, (6.5, 7.8), (7.2, 6.8), color=COLORS['grad_good'], lw=1.5)

# Mechanism 1: BN interference
m1_box = FancyBboxPatch((0.3, 4.8), 4.4, 2.0,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.2",
                         facecolor='#FDEDED', edgecolor=COLORS['bn_bad'],

ax_c.add_patch(m1_box)
ax_c.text(2.5, 6.35, 'BN Interference', ha='center', fontsize=9,

ax_c.text(2.5, 5.75, '−1.9 pp', ha='center', fontsize=10,

ax_c.text(2.5, 5.2, 'representational drift\nCKA ↓ 0.31–0.54',
          ha='center', fontsize=7, color=COLORS['text'], zorder=4,

# Mechanism 2: gradient flow absence
m2_box = FancyBboxPatch((5.3, 4.8), 4.4, 2.0,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.2",
                         facecolor='#E8F0FE', edgecolor=COLORS['grad_good'],
                         linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
ax_c.add_patch(m2_box)
ax_c.text(7.5, 6.35, 'Gradient Flow Absence', ha='center', fontsize=9,
          fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['grad_good'], zorder=4)
ax_c.text(7.5, 5.75, '−1.5 pp', ha='center', fontsize=10,
          fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['grad_good'], zorder=4)
ax_c.text(7.5, 5.2, 'existence regularization\nbehavioral, not representational',
          ha='center', fontsize=7, color=COLORS['text'], zorder=4,
          linespacing=1.4)

# Evidence arrows pointing down to evidence boxes
draw_arrow(ax_c, (2.5, 4.8), (2.5, 3.8), color=COLORS['bn_bad'], lw=1.0)
draw_arrow(ax_c, (7.5, 4.8), (7.5, 3.8), color=COLORS['grad_good'], lw=1.0)

# Evidence 1: LN recovery
ev1 = FancyBboxPatch((0.3, 2.5), 4.4, 1.3,
                      boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
                      facecolor='white', edgecolor='#DEE2E6',
                      linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)
ax_c.add_patch(ev1)
ax_c.text(2.5, 3.45, 'Evidence: LN substitution', ha='center',
          fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['text'], zorder=4)
ax_c.text(2.5, 2.9, 'Detach+LN recovers CKA\nto Vanilla level (0.96+)',

          linespacing=1.3)

# Evidence 2: representation-behavior dissociation
ev2 = FancyBboxPatch((5.3, 2.5), 4.4, 1.3,
                      boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
                      facecolor='white', edgecolor='#DEE2E6',

ax_c.add_patch(ev2)
ax_c.text(7.5, 3.45, 'Evidence: dissociation', ha='center',
          fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['text'], zorder=4)
ax_c.text(7.5, 2.9, 'CKA recovered but\nCAR still −1.5 pp',

          linespacing=1.3)

# Bottom takeaway
takeaway = FancyBboxPatch((1.5, 0.5), 7.0, 1.3,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.2",
                           facecolor='#E8F5E9', edgecolor=COLORS['action_edge'],

ax_c.add_patch(takeaway)
ax_c.text(5.0, 1.45, 'Practical Guideline', ha='center', fontsize=8.5,

ax_c.text(5.0, 0.85, 'Maintain gradient flow; if unavailable, use LN\nNo GT labels needed · Zero inference cost',
          ha='center', fontsize=7, color=COLORS['text'], zorder=4,
          linespacing=1.3)

# Save
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513/projects/occsafe_vla/docs/paper/figures'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig1_overview.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight',

fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig1_overview.pdf', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight',

print("Saved fig1_overview.png and fig1_overview.pdf")

"""
fig1_overview_v2.py — CoRL 2026 Hero Figure (Figure 1).
Three panels: (a) The Problem, (b) Our Approach, (c) Key Finding.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Arc
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# --- Color palette (Okabe-Ito inspired, colorblind-safe) ---
C = {
    'blue':      '#0072B2',   # BN / gradient flow beneficial
    'orange':    '#D55E00',   # LN / harm
    'gray':      '#7F8C8D',   # neutral / architecture
    'red':       '#CC3333',   # safety / collision
    'green':     '#009E73',   # success / action
    'text':      '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':    '#95A5A6',
    'light_bg':  '#FAFBFC',
    'enc_fill':  '#EBF0F7',
    'enc_edge':  '#0072B2',
    'llm_fill':  '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':  '#937860',
    'act_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'act_edge':  '#009E73',
    'aux_fill':  '#FFF3E0',
    'aux_edge':  '#E8870E',
    'warn_fill': '#FDE8E8',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'text.color': C['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': C['text'],
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.5), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

# Panel layout: (a) 28%, (b) 42%, (c) 28%, with gaps
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.04, 0.27, 0.88])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.305, 0.04, 0.39, 0.88])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.72, 0.04, 0.27, 0.88])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================
def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=zorder,
                            linestyle=linestyle)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): "The Problem" — Collision Scenario
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.55, '(a)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_a.text(1.05, 9.55, 'The Problem', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# --- Robot arm (side view, 3 joints + end effector) ---
# Base
base_x, base_y = 2.0, 1.0
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((base_x - 0.8, base_y - 0.6), 1.6, 0.6,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.08",
               facecolor='#BDC3C7', edgecolor='#7F8C8D', lw=1.2, zorder=5))
ax_a.text(base_x, base_y - 0.32, 'BASE', fontsize=5.5, ha='center', va='center',
          color='#555', fontweight='bold', zorder=6)

# Joint positions
j0 = (base_x, base_y)
j1 = (base_x + 0.8, base_y + 2.2)
j2 = (base_x + 2.8, base_y + 3.5)
ee = (base_x + 4.8, base_y + 3.0)  # end effector — near obstacle

# Links
for (s, e) in [(j0, j1), (j1, j2), (j2, ee)]:
    ax_a.plot([s[0], e[0]], [s[1], e[1]], color='#5D6D7E', lw=3.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)

# Joints
for j, sz in [(j0, 8), (j1, 7), (j2, 6)]:
    ax_a.plot(j[0], j[1], 'o', color='#2C3E50', markersize=sz, zorder=6)
    ax_a.plot(j[0], j[1], 'o', color='#AEB6BF', markersize=sz-2.5, zorder=7)

# End effector (gripper shape)
gx, gy = ee
ax_a.plot([gx, gx+0.3], [gy, gy+0.5], color='#5D6D7E', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)
ax_a.plot([gx, gx+0.3], [gy, gy-0.5], color='#5D6D7E', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)
ax_a.plot(gx, gy, 'o', color='#2C3E50', markersize=5, zorder=6)

# --- Obstacle ---
obs_x, obs_y = 7.0, 3.5
obs = FancyBboxPatch((obs_x - 1.0, obs_y - 1.0), 2.0, 2.0,
                      boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
                      facecolor=C['red'], edgecolor='#AA2222', lw=1.2,
                      alpha=0.25, zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(obs)
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((obs_x - 1.0, obs_y - 1.0), 2.0, 2.0,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
               facecolor='none', edgecolor=C['red'], lw=1.5, zorder=4))
ax_a.text(obs_x, obs_y, 'OBSTACLE', fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center',
          color=C['red'], fontweight='bold', zorder=5)

# Collision zone highlight
collision_circle = plt.Circle((gx + 0.6, gy), 1.1, facecolor=C['red'],
                               edgecolor=C['red'], alpha=0.12, lw=0, zorder=2)
ax_a.add_patch(collision_circle)
collision_ring = plt.Circle((gx + 0.6, gy), 1.1, facecolor='none',
                             edgecolor=C['red'], alpha=0.5, lw=1.5,
                             linestyle='--', zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(collision_ring)

# Warning symbol
ax_a.text(gx + 0.6, gy + 1.55, '⚠', fontsize=14, ha='center', va='center',
          color=C['red'], zorder=6)

# Direction arrows/annotations

# Axis styling
ax_c.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax_c.set_xticklabels(['Gradient\nOFF', 'Gradient\nON'], fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold')
ax_c.set_ylabel('Collision-Aware Rate (CAR)', fontsize=9, labelpad=8)

out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513/projects/occsafe_vla/artifacts'

"""
fig1_overview_v2.py — CoRL 2026 Hero Figure (Figure 1).
Three panels: (a) The Problem, (b) Our Approach, (c) Key Finding.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Arc
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# --- Color palette (Okabe-Ito inspired, colorblind-safe) ---
C = {
    'blue':      '#0072B2',   # BN / gradient flow beneficial
    'orange':    '#D55E00',   # LN / harm
    'gray':      '#7F8C8D',   # neutral / architecture
    'red':       '#CC3333',   # safety / collision
    'green':     '#009E73',   # success / action
    'text':      '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':    '#95A5A6',
    'light_bg':  '#FAFBFC',
    'enc_fill':  '#EBF0F7',
    'enc_edge':  '#0072B2',
    'llm_fill':  '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':  '#937860',
    'act_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'act_edge':  '#009E73',
    'aux_fill':  '#FFF3E0',
    'aux_edge':  '#E8870E',
    'warn_fill': '#FDE8E8',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'text.color': C['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': C['text'],
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.5), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

# Panel layout: (a) 28%, (b) 42%, (c) 28%, with gaps
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.04, 0.27, 0.88])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.305, 0.04, 0.39, 0.88])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.72, 0.04, 0.27, 0.88])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================
def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=zorder,
                            linestyle=linestyle)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): "The Problem" — Collision Scenario
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.55, '(a)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_a.text(1.05, 9.55, 'The Problem', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# --- Robot arm (side view, 3 joints + end effector) ---
# Base
base_x, base_y = 2.0, 1.0
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((base_x - 0.8, base_y - 0.6), 1.6, 0.6,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.08",
               facecolor='#BDC3C7', edgecolor='#7F8C8D', lw=1.2, zorder=5))
ax_a.text(base_x, base_y - 0.32, 'BASE', fontsize=5.5, ha='center', va='center',
          color='#555', fontweight='bold', zorder=6)

# Joint positions
j0 = (base_x, base_y)
j1 = (base_x + 0.8, base_y + 2.2)
j2 = (base_x + 2.8, base_y + 3.5)
ee = (base_x + 4.8, base_y + 3.0)  # end effector — near obstacle

# Links
for (s, e) in [(j0, j1), (j1, j2), (j2, ee)]:
    ax_a.plot([s[0], e[0]], [s[1], e[1]], color='#5D6D7E', lw=3.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)

# Joints
for j, sz in [(j0, 8), (j1, 7), (j2, 6)]:
    ax_a.plot(j[0], j[1], 'o', color='#2C3E50', markersize=sz, zorder=6)
    ax_a.plot(j[0], j[1], 'o', color='#AEB6BF', markersize=sz-2.5, zorder=7)

# End effector (gripper shape)
gx, gy = ee
ax_a.plot([gx, gx+0.3], [gy, gy+0.5], color='#5D6D7E', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)
ax_a.plot([gx, gx+0.3], [gy, gy-0.5], color='#5D6D7E', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)
ax_a.plot(gx, gy, 'o', color='#2C3E50', markersize=5, zorder=6)

# --- Obstacle ---
obs_x, obs_y = 7.0, 3.5
obs = FancyBboxPatch((obs_x - 1.0, obs_y - 1.0), 2.0, 2.0,
                      boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
                      facecolor=C['red'], edgecolor='#AA2222', lw=1.2,
                      alpha=0.25, zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(obs)
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((obs_x - 1.0, obs_y - 1.0), 2.0, 2.0,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
               facecolor='none', edgecolor=C['red'], lw=1.5, zorder=4))
ax_a.text(obs_x, obs_y, 'OBSTACLE', fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center',
          color=C['red'], fontweight='bold', zorder=5)

# Collision zone highlight
collision_circle = plt.Circle((gx + 0.6, gy), 1.1, facecolor=C['red'],
                               edgecolor=C['red'], alpha=0.12, lw=0, zorder=2)
ax_a.add_patch(collision_circle)
collision_ring = plt.Circle((gx + 0.6, gy), 1.1, facecolor='none',
                             edgecolor=C['red'], alpha=0.5, lw=1.5,
                             linestyle='--', zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(collision_ring)

# Warning symbol
ax_a.text(gx + 0.6, gy + 1.55, '⚠', fontsize=14, ha='center', va='center',
          color=C['red'], zorder=6)

# Trajectory arrow (dotted, showing intended motion toward obstacle)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (gx + 0.3, gy), (obs_x - 1.1, obs_y - 0.3),
           color=C['red'], lw=1.0, style='->', linestyle='--', mutation=10)

# Text annotations
ax_a.text(5.0, 7.8, 'VLA policies lack\ncollision awareness', fontsize=8,
          ha='center', va='center', color=C['text'], fontweight='bold',
          linespacing=1.4)
ax_a.text(5.0, 6.7, 'Deployed in safety-critical\nenvironments where collisions\ncause irreversible damage',
          fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center', color=C['subtle'],
          linespacing=1.4, style='italic')

# Bottom benchmark label
benchmark_box = FancyBboxPatch((0.8, 0.05), 8.4, 0.7,
                                boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.1",
                                facecolor='#F0F4F8', edgecolor='#BDC3C7',
                                lw=0.8, zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(benchmark_box)
ax_a.text(5.0, 0.4, 'SafeLIBERO benchmark: 10 tasks, collision-aware evaluation',
          fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center', color=C['text'], zorder=4)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (b): "Our Approach" — Architecture Overview
# ============================================================
ax_b.text(0.15, 9.55, '(b)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_b.text(1.05, 9.55, 'Our Approach', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# --- RGB Observation (bottom) ---
draw_box(ax_b, (3.0, 0.15), 4.0, 0.85, 'RGB Observation', fill='#F0F4F8',
         edge=C['subtle'], fontsize=8, lw=0.8, bold=False)

# --- Vision Encoders ---
draw_box(ax_b, (0.8, 1.8), 3.2, 0.9, 'DINOv2', sublabel='ViT-L patches',
         fill=C['enc_fill'], edge=C['enc_edge'], fontsize=8.5)
draw_box(ax_b, (6.0, 1.8), 3.2, 0.9, 'SigLIP', sublabel='ViT-So patches',
         fill=C['enc_fill'], edge=C['enc_edge'], fontsize=8.5)

# LoRA badges
for lx in [0.75, 5.95]:

"""
fig1_overview_v2.py — CoRL 2026 Hero Figure (Figure 1).
Three panels: (a) The Problem, (b) Our Approach, (c) Key Finding.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Arc
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# --- Color palette (Okabe-Ito inspired, colorblind-safe) ---
C = {
    'blue':      '#0072B2',   # BN / gradient flow beneficial
    'orange':    '#D55E00',   # LN / harm
    'gray':      '#7F8C8D',   # neutral / architecture
    'red':       '#CC3333',   # safety / collision
    'green':     '#009E73',   # success / action
    'text':      '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':    '#95A5A6',
    'light_bg':  '#FAFBFC',
    'enc_fill':  '#EBF0F7',
    'enc_edge':  '#0072B2',
    'llm_fill':  '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':  '#937860',
    'act_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'act_edge':  '#009E73',
    'aux_fill':  '#FFF3E0',
    'aux_edge':  '#E8870E',
    'warn_fill': '#FDE8E8',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'text.color': C['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': C['text'],
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.8), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

# Panel layout: (a) 28%, (b) 42%, (c) 28%, with gaps
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.06, 0.27, 0.87])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.305, 0.06, 0.39, 0.87])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.72, 0.08, 0.27, 0.83])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================
def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=zorder,
                            linestyle=linestyle)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): "The Problem" — Collision Scenario
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.55, '(a)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_a.text(1.05, 9.55, 'The Problem', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# --- Robot arm (side view, 3 joints + end effector) ---
# Base
base_x, base_y = 2.0, 1.0
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((base_x - 0.8, base_y - 0.6), 1.6, 0.6,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.08",
               facecolor='#BDC3C7', edgecolor='#7F8C8D', lw=1.2, zorder=5))
ax_a.text(base_x, base_y - 0.32, 'BASE', fontsize=5.5, ha='center', va='center',
          color='#555', fontweight='bold', zorder=6)

# Joint positions
j0 = (base_x, base_y)
j1 = (base_x + 0.8, base_y + 2.2)
j2 = (base_x + 2.8, base_y + 3.5)
ee = (base_x + 4.8, base_y + 3.0)  # end effector — near obstacle

# Links
for (s, e) in [(j0, j1), (j1, j2), (j2, ee)]:
    ax_a.plot([s[0], e[0]], [s[1], e[1]], color='#5D6D7E', lw=3.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)

# Joints
for j, sz in [(j0, 8), (j1, 7), (j2, 6)]:
    ax_a.plot(j[0], j[1], 'o', color='#2C3E50', markersize=sz, zorder=6)
    ax_a.plot(j[0], j[1], 'o', color='#AEB6BF', markersize=sz-2.5, zorder=7)

# End effector (gripper shape)
gx, gy = ee
ax_a.plot([gx, gx+0.3], [gy, gy+0.5], color='#5D6D7E', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)
ax_a.plot([gx, gx+0.3], [gy, gy-0.5], color='#5D6D7E', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)
ax_a.plot(gx, gy, 'o', color='#2C3E50', markersize=5, zorder=6)

# --- Obstacle ---
obs_x, obs_y = 7.0, 3.5
obs = FancyBboxPatch((obs_x - 1.0, obs_y - 1.0), 2.0, 2.0,
                      boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
                      facecolor=C['red'], edgecolor='#AA2222', lw=1.2,
                      alpha=0.25, zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(obs)
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((obs_x - 1.0, obs_y - 1.0), 2.0, 2.0,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
               facecolor='none', edgecolor=C['red'], lw=1.5, zorder=4))
ax_a.text(obs_x, obs_y, 'OBSTACLE', fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center',
          color=C['red'], fontweight='bold', zorder=5)

# Collision zone highlight
collision_circle = plt.Circle((gx + 0.6, gy), 1.1, facecolor=C['red'],
                               edgecolor=C['red'], alpha=0.12, lw=0, zorder=2)
ax_a.add_patch(collision_circle)
collision_ring = plt.Circle((gx + 0.6, gy), 1.1, facecolor='none',
                             edgecolor=C['red'], alpha=0.5, lw=1.5,
                             linestyle='--', zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(collision_ring)

# Warning symbol
ax_a.text(gx + 0.6, gy + 1.55, '⚠', fontsize=14, ha='center', va='center',
          color=C['red'], zorder=6)

# Trajectory arrow (dotted, showing intended motion toward obstacle)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (gx + 0.3, gy), (obs_x - 1.1, obs_y - 0.3),
           color=C['red'], lw=1.0, style='->', linestyle='--', mutation=10)

# Text annotations
ax_a.text(5.0, 7.8, 'VLA policies lack\ncollision awareness', fontsize=8,
          ha='center', va='center', color=C['text'], fontweight='bold',
          linespacing=1.4)
ax_a.text(5.0, 6.7, 'Deployed in safety-critical\nenvironments where collisions\ncause irreversible damage',
          fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center', color=C['subtle'],
          linespacing=1.4, style='italic')

# Bottom benchmark label
benchmark_box = FancyBboxPatch((0.8, 0.05), 8.4, 0.7,
                                boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.1",
                                facecolor='#F0F4F8', edgecolor='#BDC3C7',
                                lw=0.8, zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(benchmark_box)
ax_a.text(5.0, 0.4, 'SafeLIBERO benchmark: 10 tasks, collision-aware evaluation',
          fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center', color=C['text'], zorder=4)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (b): "Our Approach" — Architecture Overview
# ============================================================
ax_b.text(0.15, 9.55, '(b)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_b.text(1.05, 9.55, 'Our Approach', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# --- RGB Observation (bottom) ---
draw_box(ax_b, (3.0, 0.15), 4.0, 0.85, 'RGB Observation', fill='#F0F4F8',
         edge=C['subtle'], fontsize=8, lw=0.8, bold=False)

# --- Vision Encoders ---
draw_box(ax_b, (0.8, 1.8), 3.2, 0.9, 'DINOv2', sublabel='ViT-L patches',
         fill=C['enc_fill'], edge=C['enc_edge'], fontsize=8.5)
draw_box(ax_b, (6.0, 1.8), 3.2, 0.9, 'SigLIP', sublabel='ViT-So patches',

# LoRA badges
for lx in [0.75, 5.95]:

              bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.1', facecolor='white',
                        edgecolor=C['blue'], lw=0.5, alpha=0.9), zorder=5)

# BN/LN choice annotation on encoders
for ex, ey in [(2.4, 1.75), (7.6, 1.75)]:
    ax_b.text(ex, ey, 'BN', fontsize=6, color=C['blue'], fontweight='bold',
              ha='center', va='top',
              bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.08', facecolor='#E8F0FE',
                        edgecolor=C['blue'], lw=0.5), zorder=5)
    ax_b.text(ex + 0.85, ey, 'LN', fontsize=6, color=C['orange'], fontweight='bold',

              bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.08', facecolor='#FDE8E8',

    ax_b.text(ex + 0.42, ey + 0.02, '/', fontsize=6, color=C['subtle'],
              ha='center', va='top', zorder=5)

# Arrows: obs → encoders
draw_arrow(ax_b, (4.2, 1.0), (2.4, 1.8), color=C['enc_edge'], lw=1.0)
draw_arrow(ax_b, (5.8, 1.0), (7.6, 1.8), color=C['enc_edge'], lw=1.0)

# --- LLM Backbone ---
draw_box(ax_b, (2.2, 3.5), 5.6, 1.0, 'LLM Backbone', sublabel='Llama-2 7B',
         fill=C['llm_fill'], edge=C['llm_edge'], fontsize=9)

# Arrows: encoders → LLM
draw_arrow(ax_b, (2.4, 2.7), (3.8, 3.5), color='#666', lw=1.0)

"""
fig1_overview_v2.py — CoRL 2026 Hero Figure (Figure 1).
Three panels: (a) The Problem, (b) Our Approach, (c) Key Finding.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Arc
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# --- Color palette (Okabe-Ito inspired, colorblind-safe) ---
C = {
    'blue':      '#0072B2',   # BN / gradient flow beneficial
    'orange':    '#D55E00',   # LN / harm
    'gray':      '#7F8C8D',   # neutral / architecture
    'red':       '#CC3333',   # safety / collision
    'green':     '#009E73',   # success / action
    'text':      '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':    '#95A5A6',
    'light_bg':  '#FAFBFC',
    'enc_fill':  '#EBF0F7',
    'enc_edge':  '#0072B2',
    'llm_fill':  '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':  '#937860',
    'act_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'act_edge':  '#009E73',
    'aux_fill':  '#FFF3E0',
    'aux_edge':  '#E8870E',
    'warn_fill': '#FDE8E8',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'text.color': C['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': C['text'],
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.8), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

# Panel layout: (a) 28%, (b) 42%, (c) 28%, with gaps
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.06, 0.27, 0.87])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.305, 0.06, 0.39, 0.87])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.72, 0.08, 0.27, 0.83])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================
def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=zorder,
                            linestyle=linestyle)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): "The Problem" — Collision Scenario
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.55, '(a)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_a.text(1.05, 9.55, 'The Problem', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# --- Robot arm (side view, 3 joints + end effector) ---
# Base
base_x, base_y = 2.0, 1.0
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((base_x - 0.8, base_y - 0.6), 1.6, 0.6,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.08",
               facecolor='#BDC3C7', edgecolor='#7F8C8D', lw=1.2, zorder=5))
ax_a.text(base_x, base_y - 0.32, 'BASE', fontsize=5.5, ha='center', va='center',
          color='#555', fontweight='bold', zorder=6)

# Joint positions
j0 = (base_x, base_y)
j1 = (base_x + 0.8, base_y + 2.2)
j2 = (base_x + 2.8, base_y + 3.5)
ee = (base_x + 4.8, base_y + 3.0)  # end effector — near obstacle

# Links
for (s, e) in [(j0, j1), (j1, j2), (j2, ee)]:
    ax_a.plot([s[0], e[0]], [s[1], e[1]], color='#5D6D7E', lw=3.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)

# Joints
for j, sz in [(j0, 8), (j1, 7), (j2, 6)]:
    ax_a.plot(j[0], j[1], 'o', color='#2C3E50', markersize=sz, zorder=6)
    ax_a.plot(j[0], j[1], 'o', color='#AEB6BF', markersize=sz-2.5, zorder=7)

# End effector (gripper shape)
gx, gy = ee
ax_a.plot([gx, gx+0.3], [gy, gy+0.5], color='#5D6D7E', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)
ax_a.plot([gx, gx+0.3], [gy, gy-0.5], color='#5D6D7E', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)
ax_a.plot(gx, gy, 'o', color='#2C3E50', markersize=5, zorder=6)

# --- Obstacle ---
obs_x, obs_y = 7.0, 3.5
obs = FancyBboxPatch((obs_x - 1.0, obs_y - 1.0), 2.0, 2.0,
                      boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
                      facecolor=C['red'], edgecolor='#AA2222', lw=1.2,
                      alpha=0.25, zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(obs)
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((obs_x - 1.0, obs_y - 1.0), 2.0, 2.0,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
               facecolor='none', edgecolor=C['red'], lw=1.5, zorder=4))
ax_a.text(obs_x, obs_y, 'OBSTACLE', fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center',
          color=C['red'], fontweight='bold', zorder=5)

# Collision zone highlight
collision_circle = plt.Circle((gx + 0.6, gy), 1.1, facecolor=C['red'],
                               edgecolor=C['red'], alpha=0.12, lw=0, zorder=2)
ax_a.add_patch(collision_circle)
collision_ring = plt.Circle((gx + 0.6, gy), 1.1, facecolor='none',
                             edgecolor=C['red'], alpha=0.5, lw=1.5,
                             linestyle='--', zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(collision_ring)

# Warning triangle (hand-drawn, no emoji)
warn_cx, warn_cy = gx + 0.6, gy + 1.6
tri_h = 0.6
tri = plt.Polygon([(warn_cx, warn_cy + tri_h*0.6),
                    (warn_cx - tri_h*0.5, warn_cy - tri_h*0.3),
                    (warn_cx + tri_h*0.5, warn_cy - tri_h*0.3)],
                   facecolor='#FFCC02', edgecolor=C['red'], lw=1.5,
                   zorder=6, closed=True)
ax_a.add_patch(tri)
ax_a.text(warn_cx, warn_cy + 0.02, '!', fontsize=9, ha='center', va='center',
          color=C['red'], fontweight='bold', zorder=7)

# Trajectory arrow (dotted, showing intended motion toward obstacle)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (gx + 0.3, gy), (obs_x - 1.1, obs_y - 0.3),
           color=C['red'], lw=1.0, style='->', linestyle='--', mutation=10)

# Text annotations
ax_a.text(5.0, 7.8, 'VLA policies lack\ncollision awareness', fontsize=8,
          ha='center', va='center', color=C['text'], fontweight='bold',
          linespacing=1.4)
ax_a.text(5.0, 6.7, 'Deployed in safety-critical\nenvironments where collisions\ncause irreversible damage',
          fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center', color=C['subtle'],
          linespacing=1.4, style='italic')

# Bottom benchmark label
benchmark_box = FancyBboxPatch((0.8, 0.05), 8.4, 0.7,
                                boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.1",
                                facecolor='#F0F4F8', edgecolor='#BDC3C7',
                                lw=0.8, zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(benchmark_box)
ax_a.text(5.0, 0.4, 'SafeLIBERO benchmark: 10 tasks, collision-aware evaluation',
          fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center', color=C['text'], zorder=4)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (b): "Our Approach" — Architecture Overview
# ============================================================
ax_b.text(0.15, 9.55, '(b)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_b.text(1.05, 9.55, 'Our Approach', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# --- RGB Observation (bottom) ---
draw_box(ax_b, (3.0, 0.15), 4.0, 0.85, 'RGB Observation', fill='#F0F4F8',
         edge=C['subtle'], fontsize=8, lw=0.8, bold=False)

# --- Vision Encoders ---
draw_box(ax_b, (0.8, 1.8), 3.2, 0.9, 'DINOv2', sublabel='ViT-L patches',
         fill=C['enc_fill'], edge=C['enc_edge'], fontsize=8.5)
draw_box(ax_b, (6.0, 1.8), 3.2, 0.9, 'SigLIP', sublabel='ViT-So patches',
         fill=C['enc_fill'], edge=C['enc_edge'], fontsize=8.5)

# LoRA badges
for lx in [0.75, 5.95]:
    ax_b.text(lx + 0.15, 2.85, 'LoRA', fontsize=5.5, color=C['blue'], fontweight='bold',
              ha='left', style='italic',
              bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.1', facecolor='white',
                        edgecolor=C['blue'], lw=0.5, alpha=0.9), zorder=5)

# BN/LN choice annotation on encoders
for ex, ey in [(2.4, 1.75), (7.6, 1.75)]:
    ax_b.text(ex, ey, 'BN', fontsize=6, color=C['blue'], fontweight='bold',
              ha='center', va='top',
              bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.08', facecolor='#E8F0FE',
                        edgecolor=C['blue'], lw=0.5), zorder=5)
    ax_b.text(ex + 0.85, ey, 'LN', fontsize=6, color=C['orange'], fontweight='bold',
              ha='center', va='top',
              bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.08', facecolor='#FDE8E8',
                        edgecolor=C['orange'], lw=0.5), zorder=5)
    ax_b.text(ex + 0.42, ey + 0.02, '/', fontsize=6, color=C['subtle'],
              ha='center', va='top', zorder=5)

# Arrows: obs → encoders
draw_arrow(ax_b, (4.2, 1.0), (2.4, 1.8), color=C['enc_edge'], lw=1.0)
draw_arrow(ax_b, (5.8, 1.0), (7.6, 1.8), color=C['enc_edge'], lw=1.0)

# --- LLM Backbone ---
draw_box(ax_b, (2.2, 3.5), 5.6, 1.0, 'LLM Backbone', sublabel='Llama-2 7B',

def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):

                            linestyle=linestyle)

"""
fig1_overview_v2.py — CoRL 2026 Hero Figure (Figure 1).
Three panels: (a) The Problem, (b) Our Approach, (c) Key Finding.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Arc
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# --- Color palette (Okabe-Ito inspired, colorblind-safe) ---
C = {
    'blue':      '#0072B2',   # BN / gradient flow beneficial
    'orange':    '#D55E00',   # LN / harm
    'gray':      '#7F8C8D',   # neutral / architecture
    'red':       '#CC3333',   # safety / collision
    'green':     '#009E73',   # success / action
    'text':      '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':    '#95A5A6',
    'light_bg':  '#FAFBFC',
    'enc_fill':  '#EBF0F7',
    'enc_edge':  '#0072B2',
    'llm_fill':  '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':  '#937860',
    'act_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'act_edge':  '#009E73',
    'aux_fill':  '#FFF3E0',
    'aux_edge':  '#E8870E',
    'warn_fill': '#FDE8E8',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'text.color': C['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': C['text'],
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.8), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

# Panel layout: (a) 28%, (b) 42%, (c) 28%, with gaps
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.06, 0.27, 0.87])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.305, 0.06, 0.39, 0.87])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.72, 0.08, 0.27, 0.83])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================
def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=zorder,
                            linestyle=linestyle)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): "The Problem" — Collision Scenario
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.55, '(a)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_a.text(1.05, 9.55, 'The Problem', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# --- Robot arm (side view, 3 joints + end effector) ---
# Base
base_x, base_y = 2.0, 1.6
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((base_x - 0.8, base_y - 0.6), 1.6, 0.6,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.08",
               facecolor='#BDC3C7', edgecolor='#7F8C8D', lw=1.2, zorder=5))
ax_a.text(base_x, base_y - 0.32, 'BASE', fontsize=5.5, ha='center', va='center',
          color='#555', fontweight='bold', zorder=6)

# Joint positions
j0 = (base_x, base_y)
j1 = (base_x + 0.8, base_y + 1.8)
j2 = (base_x + 2.8, base_y + 2.8)
ee = (base_x + 4.8, base_y + 2.3)  # end effector — near obstacle

# Links
for (s, e) in [(j0, j1), (j1, j2), (j2, ee)]:
    ax_a.plot([s[0], e[0]], [s[1], e[1]], color='#5D6D7E', lw=3.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)

# Joints
for j, sz in [(j0, 8), (j1, 7), (j2, 6)]:

    ax_a.plot(j[0], j[1], 'o', color='#AEB6BF', markersize=sz-2.5, zorder=7)

# End effector (gripper shape)
gx, gy = ee
ax_a.plot([gx, gx+0.3], [gy, gy+0.5], color='#5D6D7E', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)
ax_a.plot([gx, gx+0.3], [gy, gy-0.5], color='#5D6D7E', lw=2.5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)

                      alpha=0.25, zorder=3)

ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((obs_x - 1.0, obs_y - 1.0), 2.0, 2.0,

ax_a.text(obs_x, obs_y, 'OBSTACLE', fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center',
          color=C['red'], fontweight='bold', zorder=5)

# Collision zone highlight
collision_circle = plt.Circle((gx + 0.6, gy), 1.1, facecolor=C['red'],
                               edgecolor=C['red'], alpha=0.12, lw=0, zorder=2)
ax_a.add_patch(collision_circle)
collision_ring = plt.Circle((gx + 0.6, gy), 1.1, facecolor='none',
                             edgecolor=C['red'], alpha=0.5, lw=1.5,
                             linestyle='--', zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(collision_ring)

# Warning triangle (hand-drawn, no emoji)
warn_cx, warn_cy = gx + 0.6, gy + 1.6
tri_h = 0.6
tri = plt.Polygon([(warn_cx, warn_cy + tri_h*0.6),
                    (warn_cx - tri_h*0.5, warn_cy - tri_h*0.3),
                    (warn_cx + tri_h*0.5, warn_cy - tri_h*0.3)],

                   zorder=6, closed=True)

ax_a.text(warn_cx, warn_cy + 0.02, '!', fontsize=9, ha='center', va='center',

# Trajectory arrow (dotted, showing intended motion toward obstacle)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (gx + 0.3, gy), (obs_x - 1.1, obs_y - 0.3),
           color=C['red'], lw=1.0, style='->', linestyle='--', mutation=10)

# Text annotations
ax_a.text(5.0, 7.8, 'VLA policies lack\ncollision awareness', fontsize=8,
          ha='center', va='center', color=C['text'], fontweight='bold',

ax_a.text(5.0, 6.7, 'Deployed in safety-critical\nenvironments where collisions\ncause irreversible damage',
          fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center', color=C['subtle'],
          linespacing=1.4, style='italic')

# Bottom benchmark label
benchmark_box = FancyBboxPatch((0.8, 0.05), 8.4, 0.7,
                                boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.1",
                                facecolor='#F0F4F8', edgecolor='#BDC3C7',
                                lw=0.8, zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(benchmark_box)
ax_a.text(5.0, 0.4, 'SafeLIBERO benchmark: 10 tasks, collision-aware evaluation',
          fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center', color=C['text'], zorder=4)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (b): "Our Approach" — Architecture Overview
# ============================================================
ax_b.text(0.15, 9.55, '(b)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_b.text(1.05, 9.55, 'Our Approach', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',

# --- RGB Observation (bottom) ---
draw_box(ax_b, (3.0, 0.15), 4.0, 0.85, 'RGB Observation', fill='#F0F4F8',

# --- Vision Encoders ---
draw_box(ax_b, (0.8, 1.8), 3.2, 0.9, 'DINOv2', sublabel='ViT-L patches',

draw_box(ax_b, (6.0, 1.8), 3.2, 0.9, 'SigLIP', sublabel='ViT-So patches',

# LoRA badges
for lx in [0.75, 5.95]:

    ax_b.text(ex + 0.42, ey + 0.02, '/', fontsize=6, color=C['subtle'],

# Arrows: obs → encoders
draw_arrow(ax_b, (4.2, 1.0), (2.4, 1.8), color=C['enc_edge'], lw=1.0)
draw_arrow(ax_b, (5.8, 1.0), (7.6, 1.8), color=C['enc_edge'], lw=1.0)

Three panels: (a) The Problem, (b) Our Approach, (c) Key Finding.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Arc
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# --- Color palette (Okabe-Ito inspired, colorblind-safe) ---
C = {
    'blue':      '#0072B2',   # BN / gradient flow beneficial
    'orange':    '#D55E00',   # LN / harm
    'gray':      '#7F8C8D',   # neutral / architecture
    'red':       '#CC3333',   # safety / collision
    'green':     '#009E73',   # success / action
    'text':      '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':    '#95A5A6',
    'light_bg':  '#FAFBFC',
    'enc_fill':  '#EBF0F7',
    'enc_edge':  '#0072B2',
    'llm_fill':  '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':  '#937860',
    'act_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'act_edge':  '#009E73',
    'aux_fill':  '#FFF3E0',
    'aux_edge':  '#E8870E',
    'warn_fill': '#FDE8E8',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'text.color': C['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': C['text'],
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.8), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

# Panel layout: (a) 28%, (b) 42%, (c) 28%, with gaps

ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.305, 0.06, 0.39, 0.87])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================
def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=zorder,
                            linestyle=linestyle)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): "The Problem" — Collision Scenario
# ============================================================

ax_a.text(1.05, 9.55, 'The Problem', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',

# --- Robot arm (side view, 3 joints + end effector) ---

          color='#555', fontweight='bold', zorder=6)

# Joint positions

               facecolor='none', edgecolor=C['red'], lw=1.5, zorder=4))
ax_a.text(obs_x, obs_y, 'OBSTACLE', fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center',

# ============================================================

"""
fig1_overview_v2.py — CoRL 2026 Hero Figure (Figure 1).
Three panels: (a) The Problem, (b) Our Approach, (c) Key Finding.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# --- Color palette (Okabe-Ito inspired, colorblind-safe) ---
C = {
    'blue':      '#0072B2',
    'orange':    '#D55E00',
    'gray':      '#7F8C8D',
    'red':       '#CC3333',
    'green':     '#009E73',
    'text':      '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':    '#95A5A6',
    'enc_fill':  '#EBF0F7',
    'enc_edge':  '#0072B2',
    'llm_fill':  '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':  '#937860',
    'act_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'act_edge':  '#009E73',
    'aux_fill':  '#FFF3E0',
    'aux_edge':  '#E8870E',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'text.color': C['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': C['text'],
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.8), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

# Panel layout: (a) 27%, gap, (b) 40%, gap, (c) 27%
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.06, 0.27, 0.87])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.30, 0.06, 0.40, 0.87])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.735, 0.13, 0.255, 0.78])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================
def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=zorder,
                            linestyle=linestyle)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): "The Problem" — Collision Scenario
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.6, '(a)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_a.text(1.1, 9.6, 'The Problem', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# --- Robot arm (side view, 3 joints + end effector) ---
base_x, base_y = 1.8, 1.8
# Base plate
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((base_x - 0.9, base_y - 0.7), 1.8, 0.65,

"""
fig1_overview_v2.py — CoRL 2026 Hero Figure (Figure 1).
Three panels: (a) The Problem, (b) Our Approach, (c) Key Finding.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# --- Color palette (Okabe-Ito inspired, colorblind-safe) ---
C = {
    'blue':      '#0072B2',
    'orange':    '#D55E00',
    'gray':      '#7F8C8D',
    'red':       '#CC3333',
    'green':     '#009E73',
    'text':      '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':    '#95A5A6',
    'enc_fill':  '#EBF0F7',
    'enc_edge':  '#0072B2',
    'llm_fill':  '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':  '#937860',
    'act_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'act_edge':  '#009E73',
    'aux_fill':  '#FFF3E0',
    'aux_edge':  '#E8870E',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'text.color': C['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': C['text'],
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.8), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

# Panel layout: (a) 27%, gap, (b) 40%, gap, (c) 27%
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.06, 0.27, 0.87])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.30, 0.06, 0.40, 0.87])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.735, 0.13, 0.255, 0.78])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================
def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=zorder,
                            linestyle=linestyle)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): "The Problem" — Collision Scenario
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.6, '(a)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_a.text(1.1, 9.6, 'The Problem', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# --- Robot arm (side view, 3 joints + end effector) ---
base_x, base_y = 1.8, 1.8
# Base plate
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((base_x - 0.9, base_y - 0.7), 1.8, 0.65,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.08",
               facecolor='#BDC3C7', edgecolor='#7F8C8D', lw=1.2, zorder=5))
ax_a.text(base_x, base_y - 0.38, 'BASE', fontsize=5.5, ha='center', va='center',
          color='#555', fontweight='bold', zorder=6)

# Joint positions (compact arm reaching right)
j0 = (base_x, base_y)
j1 = (base_x + 1.0, base_y + 2.0)
j2 = (base_x + 3.0, base_y + 3.0)
ee = (base_x + 4.5, base_y + 2.2)

# Links
for (s, e) in [(j0, j1), (j1, j2), (j2, ee)]:
    ax_a.plot([s[0], e[0]], [s[1], e[1]], color='#5D6D7E', lw=3.8,
              solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)

# Joints

fig1_overview_v2.py — CoRL 2026 Hero Figure (Figure 1).
Three panels: (a) The Problem, (b) Our Approach, (c) Key Finding.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# --- Color palette (Okabe-Ito inspired, colorblind-safe) ---
C = {
    'blue':      '#0072B2',
    'orange':    '#D55E00',
    'gray':      '#7F8C8D',
    'red':       '#CC3333',
    'green':     '#009E73',
    'text':      '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':    '#95A5A6',
    'enc_fill':  '#EBF0F7',
    'enc_edge':  '#0072B2',
    'llm_fill':  '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':  '#937860',
    'act_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'act_edge':  '#009E73',
    'aux_fill':  '#FFF3E0',
    'aux_edge':  '#E8870E',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'text.color': C['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': C['text'],
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.8), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

# Panel layout: (a) 27%, gap, (b) 40%, gap, (c) 27%
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.06, 0.27, 0.87])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.30, 0.06, 0.40, 0.87])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:

    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================
def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=zorder,
                            linestyle=linestyle)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.6, '(a)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_a.text(1.1, 9.6, 'The Problem', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.08",

          color='#555', fontweight='bold', zorder=6)

# Joint positions (compact arm reaching right)

ee = (base_x + 4.5, base_y + 2.2)

# Links
for (s, e) in [(j0, j1), (j1, j2), (j2, ee)]:

# End effector (gripper)

# --- Obstacle (positioned away from arm, to the right) ---

ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((obs_x - 1.0, obs_y - 1.0), 2.0, 2.0,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
               facecolor='none', edgecolor=C['red'], lw=1.5, zorder=4))
ax_a.text(obs_x, obs_y, 'OBSTACLE', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center',
          color=C['red'], fontweight='bold', zorder=5)

# Collision zone highlight (centered between gripper and obstacle)
coll_cx = (gx + obs_x) / 2 + 0.3
coll_cy = (gy + obs_y) / 2
collision_circle = plt.Circle((coll_cx, coll_cy), 1.3, facecolor=C['red'],

"""
fig1_overview_v2.py — CoRL 2026 Hero Figure (Figure 1).
Three panels: (a) The Problem, (b) Our Approach, (c) Key Finding.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# --- Color palette (Okabe-Ito inspired, colorblind-safe) ---
C = {
    'blue':      '#0072B2',
    'orange':    '#D55E00',
    'gray':      '#7F8C8D',
    'red':       '#CC3333',
    'green':     '#009E73',
    'text':      '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':    '#95A5A6',
    'enc_fill':  '#EBF0F7',
    'enc_edge':  '#0072B2',
    'llm_fill':  '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':  '#937860',
    'act_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'act_edge':  '#009E73',
    'aux_fill':  '#FFF3E0',
    'aux_edge':  '#E8870E',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'text.color': C['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': C['text'],
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.8), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

# Panel layout: (a) 27%, gap, (b) 40%, gap, (c) 27%
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.06, 0.27, 0.87])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.30, 0.06, 0.40, 0.87])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.735, 0.13, 0.255, 0.78])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================
def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=zorder,
                            linestyle=linestyle)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): "The Problem" — Collision Scenario
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.6, '(a)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_a.text(1.1, 9.6, 'The Problem', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# --- Robot arm (side view, 3 joints + end effector) ---
base_x, base_y = 1.8, 1.8
# Base plate
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((base_x - 0.9, base_y - 0.7), 1.8, 0.65,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.08",
               facecolor='#BDC3C7', edgecolor='#7F8C8D', lw=1.2, zorder=5))
ax_a.text(base_x, base_y - 0.38, 'BASE', fontsize=5.5, ha='center', va='center',
          color='#555', fontweight='bold', zorder=6)

# Joint positions (compact arm reaching right)
j0 = (base_x, base_y)
j1 = (base_x + 1.0, base_y + 2.0)
j2 = (base_x + 3.0, base_y + 3.0)
ee = (base_x + 4.5, base_y + 2.2)

# Links
for (s, e) in [(j0, j1), (j1, j2), (j2, ee)]:
    ax_a.plot([s[0], e[0]], [s[1], e[1]], color='#5D6D7E', lw=3.8,
              solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)

# Joints
for j, sz in [(j0, 8), (j1, 7), (j2, 6.5)]:
    ax_a.plot(j[0], j[1], 'o', color='#2C3E50', markersize=sz, zorder=6)
    ax_a.plot(j[0], j[1], 'o', color='#AEB6BF', markersize=sz-2.5, zorder=7)

# End effector (gripper)
gx, gy = ee
ax_a.plot([gx, gx+0.35], [gy, gy+0.5], color='#5D6D7E', lw=2.5,
          solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)
ax_a.plot([gx, gx+0.35], [gy, gy-0.5], color='#5D6D7E', lw=2.5,
          solid_capstyle='round', zorder=4)
ax_a.plot(gx, gy, 'o', color='#2C3E50', markersize=5, zorder=6)

# --- Obstacle (positioned away from arm, to the right) ---
obs_x, obs_y = 7.8, 4.0
obs = FancyBboxPatch((obs_x - 1.0, obs_y - 1.0), 2.0, 2.0,
                      boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
                      facecolor=C['red'], edgecolor='#AA2222', lw=1.2,
                      alpha=0.22, zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(obs)
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((obs_x - 1.0, obs_y - 1.0), 2.0, 2.0,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
               facecolor='none', edgecolor=C['red'], lw=1.5, zorder=4))
ax_a.text(obs_x, obs_y, 'OBSTACLE', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center',
          color=C['red'], fontweight='bold', zorder=5)

# Collision zone highlight (centered between gripper and obstacle)
coll_cx = (gx + obs_x) / 2 + 0.3
coll_cy = (gy + obs_y) / 2
collision_circle = plt.Circle((coll_cx, coll_cy), 1.3, facecolor=C['red'],
                               edgecolor='none', alpha=0.08, lw=0, zorder=2)
ax_a.add_patch(collision_circle)
collision_ring = plt.Circle((coll_cx, coll_cy), 1.3, facecolor='none',
                             edgecolor=C['red'], alpha=0.45, lw=1.5,
                             linestyle='--', zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(collision_ring)

# Warning triangle (matplotlib-drawn)
warn_cx, warn_cy = coll_cx, coll_cy + 1.7
tri_h = 0.7
tri = plt.Polygon([(warn_cx, warn_cy + tri_h*0.55),
                    (warn_cx - tri_h*0.5, warn_cy - tri_h*0.3),
                    (warn_cx + tri_h*0.5, warn_cy - tri_h*0.3)],
                   facecolor='#FFCC02', edgecolor=C['red'], lw=1.5,
                   zorder=6, closed=True)
ax_a.add_patch(tri)
ax_a.text(warn_cx, warn_cy + 0.0, '!', fontsize=10, ha='center', va='center',
          color=C['red'], fontweight='bold', zorder=7)

# Trajectory arrow (dotted)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (gx + 0.35, gy + 0.1), (obs_x - 1.15, obs_y - 0.2),
           color=C['red'], lw=1.0, style='->', linestyle='--', mutation=10)

# Text annotations
ax_a.text(5.0, 8.2, 'VLA policies lack\ncollision awareness', fontsize=8.5,
          ha='center', va='center', color=C['text'], fontweight='bold',
          linespacing=1.4)
ax_a.text(5.0, 7.0, 'Deployed in safety-critical\nenvironments where collisions\ncause irreversible damage',
          fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center', color=C['subtle'],
          linespacing=1.4, style='italic')

# Bottom benchmark label
benchmark_box = FancyBboxPatch((0.5, 0.05), 9.0, 0.7,
                                boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.1",
                                facecolor='#F0F4F8', edgecolor='#BDC3C7',
                                lw=0.8, zorder=3)
ax_a.add_patch(benchmark_box)
ax_a.text(5.0, 0.4, 'SafeLIBERO benchmark: 10 tasks, collision-aware evaluation',
          fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center', color=C['text'], zorder=4)

# ============================================================
# PANEL (b): "Our Approach" — Architecture Overview
# ============================================================
ax_b.text(0.15, 9.6, '(b)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_b.text(1.1, 9.6, 'Our Approach', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# --- RGB Observation (bottom) ---
draw_box(ax_b, (3.0, 0.2), 4.0, 0.8, 'RGB Observation', fill='#F0F4F8',
         edge=C['subtle'], fontsize=8, lw=0.8, bold=False)

# --- Vision Encoders ---
enc_y = 1.8
draw_box(ax_b, (0.6, enc_y), 3.4, 1.0, 'DINOv2', sublabel='ViT-L patches',
         fill=C['enc_fill'], edge=C['enc_edge'], fontsize=8.5)
draw_box(ax_b, (6.0, enc_y), 3.4, 1.0, 'SigLIP', sublabel='ViT-So patches',
         fill=C['enc_fill'], edge=C['enc_edge'], fontsize=8.5)

# LoRA badges (on top of encoder boxes)
for lx in [0.55, 5.95]:
    ax_b.text(lx + 0.15, enc_y + 1.15, 'LoRA', fontsize=6, color=C['blue'],
              fontweight='bold', ha='left', style='italic',
              bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.12', facecolor='white',
                        edgecolor=C['blue'], lw=0.5, alpha=0.9), zorder=5)

# BN / LN choice badges (below encoder boxes, more prominent)
for ex in [2.3, 7.7]:

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch

    'orange':    '#D55E00',
    'gray':      '#7F8C8D',

    'text':      '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':    '#95A5A6',

    'enc_edge':  '#0072B2',
    'llm_fill':  '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':  '#937860',
    'act_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'act_edge':  '#009E73',
    'aux_fill':  '#FFF3E0',
    'aux_edge':  '#E8870E',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'text.color': C['text'],

    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,

    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)

def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=zorder,
                            linestyle=linestyle)

# ============================================================

# ============================================================

          color=C['text'])

# Text annotations
ax_a.text(5.0, 8.2, 'VLA policies lack\ncollision awareness', fontsize=8.5,

ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.30, 0.06, 0.40, 0.87])

                               transform=fig.transFigure, color='#E0E0E0',
                               lw=0.7, zorder=0))

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================
def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=8.5, lw=1.2, radius=0.15, alpha=1.0, label_color=None,
             sublabel_color=None, bold=True):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
                         zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    lc = label_color or C['text']
    sc = sublabel_color or C['subtle']
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.18, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.25, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                color=sc, zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight=fw, color=lc, zorder=4)

def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.2, style='->', mutation=12,
               linestyle='-', zorder=2):

                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=zorder,
                            linestyle=linestyle)

# ============================================================

ax_a.text(0.15, 9.6, '(a)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=C['text'])
ax_a.text(1.1, 9.6, 'The Problem', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          color=C['text'])

# Robot arm
base_x, base_y = 1.8, 1.8
ax_a.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((base_x - 0.9, base_y - 0.7), 1.8, 0.65,
               boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.08",

ax_a.text(base_x, base_y - 0.38, 'BASE', fontsize=5.5, ha='center', va='center',

j0 = (base_x, base_y)
